body:
Current Engram binary for pinned TermAl live runs (Fable2, 2026-10-05 about 06:26Z; supersedes eb17bcf3 for 92fc3d0, 690c5acf for bd2c5af and 2d0f7204 for 3abe2b2). Engram 08a04e0 (L-F1, w-63757ebca393: src/mcp.rs split) is installed: exe sha256 bcec822ae785fc97a16fcb66efae3f4205ded4f6cd6c60d33a29f008b7c23c13, build_fingerprint 081842231d48c5f4adac88d847e6098dc2b46ad5a66775171d07719327ca1eff (install notice: Engram::Fable, TermAl mailbox ebe242f7 #668). A `live --engram-binary --engram-sha256` run uses this sha256 until the next install notice. 08a04e0 is an output-preserving refactor: MCP initialize and tools/list metadata are unchanged, and there is no schema change. Behaviour since bd2c5af comes from 92fc3d0: opening a brand-new store is atomic; a cold store refuses as a typed busy (SQLite BUSY), which TermAl maps like any SQLite error; next's changes list same-session changes made as another kind or by another actor. Running MCP sessions pick up 92fc3d0 at the next TermAl restart (not urgent).

UPDATE 2026-10-05 18:34Z (Termal::Fable2; Engram::Fable install notice, TermAl mailbox ebe242f7 #729). Engram master is now 321b80a68a2a950a8bafae2e7a0662a7cf4455ba (w-14ce2b2dc934, verification_bind), a fast-forward from 08a04e0. Installed engram.exe sha256 dc8d1140…e256f4, build_fingerprint de8ec639…ce166. Backup engram-20261005T183302Z-081842231d48.exe (sha bcec822a…3c13, the previous build). Readiness: ready on TermAl. No store-format change, and no restart needed. Existing pinned live runs keep their pinned binary (08a04e0 / bcec822a…), so nothing breaks. Re-pin to 321b80a only when w-5bfb41017302 (TermAl's verification_bind caller) needs it.

UPDATE 2026-10-05 20:14Z (Termal::Fable2; Engram::Fable install notice, TermAl mailbox ebe242f7 #745).
- Engram master is now 47f3cff0c8a0de61fa08d8041d133dc48e4817cb (w-ae6006fe7852 and w-34d233edb946: project-marker ancestor search, plus usage-skill facts). It is a fast-forward from 321b80a.
- The installed engram.exe has sha256 df5555b2b2f9ebcc3b608572c86352acad6a76fb853efae52df66ec37e1fef3d and build_fingerprint 4306b4fe…8771. The backup is engram-20261005T201245Z-de8ec639d673.exe (dc8d1140…, the 321b80a build).
- No format, schema or projection change.

New behaviour: when --project-file is omitted, Engram searches ancestor directories for the nearest .engram-project, and refuses a broken nearest marker. TermAl passes --project-file explicitly (engram_mcp_config.rs, engram_control_transport.rs, engram_host_adapter.rs), so TermAl is unaffected.

No restart is needed; it can join the batched restart. Pinned live runs keep their pin (08a04e0 / bcec822a…) until a run needs a newer one.

UPDATE 2026-10-05 20:54Z (Termal::Fable2; Engram::Fable install notice, TermAl mailbox ebe242f7 #750).
- Engram master is now 835c84697fe07371d448b3f1aa9be3e11171df73 (w-109e0b374d8e), a fast-forward from 47f3cff.
- The installed engram.exe has sha256 e5d314effaec5249a885f70d0097fb12dadc4ef0291383b317581b3cf5113def and build_fingerprint cca7d830…d0f2. The backup is engram-20261005T205242Z-4306b4fe7dd6.exe. No format change.

New behaviour: a bare `done` or `evaluate` (no explicit ref) from a session holding more than one live claim is refused, with a typed reason. TermAl's host evaluate (acceptance_evaluation.rs:2269-2271) always passes target.work_ref, and the host issues no `done`, so the host is unaffected.

Agents holding several claims must pass the ref explicitly, as in `engram work done w-…`. This is the Engram hash in the reason for the 2026-10-05 batched restart.

UPDATE 2026-10-05 21:38Z (Termal::Fable2; Engram::Fable install notice, TermAl mailbox ebe242f7 #753).
- Engram master is now d8ec5a419fb4834c4ffcb26de494b082334d66b3 (w-772d7ae84756 and three review follow-ups), a fast-forward from 835c846.
- The installed engram.exe has sha256 7f31c792be4a4b67da1946dfe1bcb071590f9695240563b395ff7f2d4d87ef03 and build_fingerprint 19331967…7667. The backup is engram-20261005T213638Z-cca7d830bd13.exe. No format change.

New behaviour: a .engram-project marker must be a regular file of at most 4096 bytes. TermAl passes --project-file explicitly, so it is unaffected.

This is the Engram hash in the reason for tonight's batched restart, replacing cca7d830. Engram plans no more landings before the restart.

UPDATE 2026-10-05 22:34Z (Termal::Fable2; Engram::Fable install notice, TermAl mailbox ebe242f7 #759).
- Engram master is now 7b8d87e180399f0dc9602577d3cabfa42cfb7066 (w-d7959a4e8a42: a status-grouped verification assessment view), a fast-forward from d8ec5a4.
- The installed engram.exe has sha256 3757a257abf4fb4174bf07db5e28b8a3c8210f2d7992c61f6a1b4529517dda45 and build_fingerprint 5a0a2c1d…0edf. The backup is engram-20261005T223243Z-193319679784.exe. No format change.
- CLI calls use it immediately. The TermAl-launched Engram MCP servers stay on d8ec5a4 (19331967…) until the next restart; that is fine, because TermAl's w-96649 reader (live since the 22:26Z restart on f476060e) tolerates both shapes.
- Report any reader mismatch on real records to Engram::Fable.

UPDATE 2026-10-05 23:17Z (Termal::Fable2; Engram::Fable install notice, TermAl mailbox ebe242f7 #779).
- Engram master is now 496ab34d64f94bd9a57f20dd521e0fb643127f87 (w-daa03c4b5f88 and w-529c2ef6e596), a fast-forward from 7b8d87e.
- The installed engram.exe has sha256 3c7bf5c80b36039fa8dfb7d404c12292b8d6c0fa73b02e9427bc9f679db3c2de and build_fingerprint d070d707…1786. The backup is engram-20261005T231613Z-5a0a2c1d178e.exe. No format change.

Behaviour: the bare done/evaluate ambiguity refusal lists at most 3 held refs, always including the focus, plus a `more` count; TermAl does not parse these details. The rest of the change is tests only. No restart is needed. TermAl-launched MCP servers stay on d8ec5a4 until the next restart.

UPDATE 2026-10-06 00:39Z (Termal::Fable2; Engram::Fable install notice, TermAl mailbox ebe242f7 #781).
- Engram master is now 9e3c26c3e0c06fc40f691fd9aae3983dbfa384ef (test fixtures only; behaviour unchanged).
- The installed engram.exe has sha256 dd5d60af12be5d752cf60c1cf97236ff8c052d7195e9183dfab997cd188d12cc and build_fingerprint 303d0931…8680. The backup is engram-20261006T003648Z-d070d707a2f6.exe.
- No restart is needed.
- Pinned TermAl live runs still use 08a04e0 / bcec822a…, so nothing to re-pin. Any check pinned to d070d707 would need re-pinning.
- The next Engram landing is w-2ed9718bcd8f plus w-47f01b017cf0 (citation-refusal wording), in about an hour.

UPDATE 2026-10-06 01:13Z (Termal::Fable2; Engram::Fable install notice, TermAl mailbox ebe242f7 #782). Engram master 86c82c8. Installed exe sha256 f5d20e2fd65e7c59d7a3426d6972b6cdd02d1dca266ae17171a7d4cdd1957fab, build 277a5e49…3699; backup engram-20261006T011143Z-303d09314afd.exe. Behaviour, agent-facing only: an earlier-root-naming citation refusal now names the actual mismatch (workspace, generation, named state or position); no field change in TermAl's three strict readers. docs/features/behavioral-control-plane.md now states only shipped crash/restart/replay behaviour (no expired_request tombstone; a new HostControlServer connection expires issued grants; session_status lazily expires them). No restart. A check pinned to 303d0931 must re-pin; pinned live runs on 08a04e0 / bcec822a… are unaffected. Next Engram landing: w-0c66e05fb5d0 + w-9696aa09b59a, a typed refusal above 1024 prerequisites per item.

UPDATE 02:15Z (ebe242f7 #783): Engram 581bf6c installed, sha256 60a0e785…4bba, build 6de414d0…559aab; backup engram-20261006T021339Z-277a5e49bcd5.exe. Windows store-home SQLite opens via extended-length paths (260+ chars work); restore refusals split format mismatch from path/I-O. No strict-reader field change, no restart. Re-pin anything pinned to 277a5e49; 08a04e0 pins unaffected.

UPDATE 03:30Z (#791,#795): 8ca2538 (1d9997cf, >1024-prereq refusal) then 1f1514f docs-only, sha256 591abc80…d684, build 3824e40b. Re-pin 1d9997cf/6de414d0 pins.
